scope: Remove post-construction Method admission and arbitrary native/source pairing. Retain source validation, capture-shape and lifetime obligations at compiled-code constructors.
architecture_review: No generic admission operation or private getter/vtable construction remains in Execution reflection. Unknown code is rejected during source pairing even if its reflection getter or an admission selector is replaced. Existing code owners validate same-program reconstruction; native Methods need no portable source. No Id change or replacement registry.
verified: both compiler modes retain source identity and checked capture shape
unknown native/source pairing rejected without calling a reinstated admission selector
wrong program, wrong shape and null capture rejection
native code remains usable without source metadata
captured aliases and repeated Block construction use established shape facts
one-time image-shell completion and nested captures
transparent continuations and optimizer recovery without effect replay
limitations: Focused tests used a fresh copy of the completed direct-definition development prefix with rebuilt Execution. This is not final cold-release qualification.
The older native-ABI optimizer/publication probes and optimizer-construction purity audit remain pending.
